# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| all     | ✅        |

No official release has been published yet. All security issues reported will be addressed.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

To report a security vulnerability, please contact us directly via:

- **Discord**: https://discord.gg/6yNACMQqV9
- **Mail**: contact@havel-ctf.com

Please do **not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

We will respond within 72 hours.
